elaine (PM): Quick sync — I pulled together tradeoffs for offline/operator shipping. Need to pick minimal acceptance criteria for GA. Thoughts?
ravi (eng): +1. We should separate 'installer' vs 'operator' scopes. Operator = continuous upgrades, minimal manual steps.
maria (field): Customers want zero DNS changes and preserved egress IP. Major blocker: netops won't allow customer to change routing.
tony (netops): If we promise preserved egress, we need either static IP allocation or a relay. Both add ops.
elaine (PM): Proposed GA acceptance: 1) unattended install with operator, 2) automated upgrade from X->Y, 3) network config limited to one outbound port, 4) documented fallback to relay.
ravi (eng): For upgrades we need operator shim that can do schema migrations. Current proto: `kubectl apply -f redwood-operator.yaml` then `rctl upgrade --from 1.2 --to 1.3` — we can make it idemp but tests needed.
samir (solutions): Field ask: an "almost airgap" pattern where customers host a relay in DMZ. Could we ship a small relay image + docs? That reduces netops asks.
tony (netops): Relay is fine but customers still need outbound to our registry or to their proxy. For airgapped customers we need offline bundle + digest-signed images.
ravi (eng): Offline bundle doable. Will add signed manifests and sha checks. Will increase package size — ~1.2GB per arch.
nora (eng-sre): Ops concern: we need telemetry opt-in and local metrics export; ensure KMS/HSM integration for key material during K8s rollout.
elaine (PM): Launch criteria draft: install time < 30m (operator-only case), offline bundle validated on two customer sites, network changes limited to one egress port, documented rollback < 15m, upgrade tested with canary rollout.
maria (field): Also add "customer-run smoke test script" that returns 0/1 so field can sign-off. I can own the checklist.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: private-operator-v1.3-beta -> staging at 1737777900 :rocket: 
elaine (PM): Next steps: Ravi will prototype offline bundle and operator shim. Maria will scope field validation matrix. Tony will draft preserved-egress options (static IP vs relay). We'll reconvene Thurs 10am.
samir (solutions): +1. I'll draft a one-pager for sales with support expectations.
elaine (PM): thanks all :thumbsup:
